_doc: COUNCIL-PANEL-BENCH cases (P6). `title` is the PR's own merged title (commitizen prefix dropped) — what a real reviewer is given. Each case is a historical PR whose merged state carried defects that a LATER PR fixed on the same code. base..head is the diff the council reviews; knownDefects is the ground truth for recall. Evidence: fixedBy commits + (where one exists) the archived FINAL-REVIEW. Lines are hints at `head` (matching tolerates drift); files are exact repo paths at `head`. changedDomains is the closed-vocab domain set the diff touches (same vocabulary as web/scripts/__fixtures__/council-catalog/profiles.json).

cases.head: 3dee080
cases.title: auto-proceed Task 11 wire-up — 11.6 + 11.7 + 11.8 integration
cases.evidence: docs/history/council/review-output/2026-05-15-0336/FINAL-REVIEW.md (7 P1, reviewed at 3dee080); fixed by #55 (5 P1), #56 (P1 #6, #7), #57 (P1 #4)

knownDefects.summary: Idle-timer denylist gate fails open silently when idleTimerProbe is null.
Synthetic-send path lacks the orchestrator turn-state gate; TOCTOU allows duplicate user frames.
isSyntheticTurnInFlight double-get torn read plus operator-precedence footgun.
Non-exhaustive BridgeObserverWakeOutcome mapping in index.ts; new variants silently stringify.
archiveSession clears the pending synthetic turn only after the archiveGroup await (race).
No replay test exercises the server:auto-proceed recorder origin.
Session-orchestrator wiring of the new call sites has no behavioural test (mock built, never asserted).

cases.title: dynamic Claude model list via Anthropic /v1/models
cases.evidence: docs/history/council/review-output/2026-06-04-1826/FINAL-REVIEW.md (4 P1 on the burndown that was squashed into #91); fixed by #92 (a96a38a)

knownDefects.summary: rAF autofocus test simulates focus instead of verifying it lands.
resolveCoalescedSignal is unreachable in production: no caller threads parentSignal.
"Footnote not inside listbox" test queries the wrong renderer instance.
Settings-slice reject-after-success test cannot fail: both branches set the same state shape.

cases.title: retry init thread/start on "Not initialized" race + re-arm spawn checkpoint after observer relaunch; make onInitError additive so the launcher's recovery survives bridge attach
cases.evidence: Carmack council review of #172/#173 (3 P1, not archived); fixed by #174 (1a68032), whose message lists the P1s

knownDefects.summary: Checkpoint and review filenames are not group-scoped, so two council pairs sharing a workspace overwrite each other's files.
The spawn-checkpoint poll is re-armed only on the manual REST relaunch, not on auto-relaunch or boot recovery.
The deadline-rescan ownership branch (recovery-path mirror of the headline fix) has no tests.

cases.head: 49643d6
cases.title: normalize codex observer reviews server-side so they parse
cases.evidence: fixed by #122 (9b98563): the normalizer fixed only the envelope; every Codex review with a non-empty findings array was still dropped

knownDefects.summary: normalizeCodexObserverReviewRaw normalizes only the envelope; Codex-native findings (severity critical/high, file, line, title) still fail parsing, so any review that found something is dropped.

cases.head: 9b98563
cases.title: normalize codex finding shape so non-empty reviews parse
cases.evidence: fixed by #123 (35eb5b9): a finding with line 0 maps to evidence_lines [0,0], parseLineRange rejects it and the whole normalized review is dropped

knownDefects.summary: normalizeCodexFinding maps any integer line (including 0) to evidence_lines; line 0 fails parseLineRange and drops the entire review.

cases.title: silent-stdio drift detector — periodic transcript vs jsonl freshness check
cases.evidence: fixed by #201 (4f47e7a, signal polluted by non-CLI transcript writes; verified on prod) and #204 (902965c, slug ignores underscores; verified on prod)

knownDefects.summary: Drift is gated on the transcript file mtime, which Bun also rewrites on non-CLI events (browser subscribe, state mutations, recording flushes), so a silently dead stdio pipe is never detected.
resolveJsonlPath replaces only '/' with '-'; the CLI also maps '_', so cwds with underscores resolve to a missing jsonl and the detector is blind.
